g.text: within two years, against four to nine before
When each technology became mainstream in American
business and in US defence and intelligence agencies
Dots: midpoints of the range of years (lines) in which each technology became mainstream; milestones vary by row (a policy memo,
a big contract, a new unit or user numbers). Business-side years, except for generative AI's, and the agencies' years for open
source are the author's estimates. Gap: years from business to the agencies (range in brackets). Projection: hollow dot, median; bar,
Sources: Linux Journal; Defense One; DISA; DoD CIO; Washington Technology; CIA and DoD contract announcements; Wikipedia;
DoD CDAO; CDO Magazine; Fortune; Air Force Times; DefenseScoop; McKinsey; author's Bayesian interval-censored regression of
